question: Who won the Best Male Athlete of the Year award at the 37th National Games event?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Srihari Nataraj**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Srihari Nataraj**, an accomplished Indian swimmer, was honored with the **Best Male Athlete of the Year award** at the 37th National Games.
 
• He showcased exceptional performances in various swimming events during the competition, securing multiple medals.
 
• Srihari specializes in **backstroke swimming** and is widely regarded as one of India’s top swimmers in the sport.
 
• His achievements at the National Games have solidified his reputation as a leading figure in Indian aquatic sports.
 
• The National Games serve as India’s premier multi-sport event, where athletes from across the country compete at the highest level.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sajan Prakash**

 
 
• Sajan Prakash is another prominent Indian swimmer who has represented the country in multiple international events, including the Olympics and Asian Games.
 
• He specializes in butterfly stroke and individual medley events.
 
• Sajan was the first Indian swimmer to breach the Olympic "A" qualification mark, achieving this feat for the Tokyo 2020 Olympics.
 
 
 
• **Arokia Rajiv**
 
 
• Arokia Rajiv is an Indian track and field athlete specializing in the 400-meter sprint.
 
• He has been part of India’s 4x400m relay team, winning medals in events like the Asian Games and Commonwealth Games.
 
• His contribution to Indian athletics, especially in relay events, has been significant in recent years.
 
 
 
• **Shivpal Singh**
 
 
• Shivpal Singh is an Indian javelin thrower who has represented the country in international competitions.
 
• He qualified for the Tokyo 2020 Olympics and has consistently performed well in Asian-level competitions.
 
• Shivpal is known for his dedication to the sport and his efforts to improve his rankings globally.
